style: A game item icon sheet for a cozy mobile game. Style: cozy flat cel-shaded illustration, clean thin dark-brown outline (#4a2e1f) around every object, flat colours plus exactly one shade step, one small white highlight, light from the upper-left, consistent 3/4 top-down view, warm palette (cream, honey, terracotta, mint, teal, soft brown) like a storybook medieval village game. No gradients, no texture noise, no hatching, no realistic rendering. Each icon is a single chunky object with a simple bold silhouette that stays readable at 48 pixels. Background: completely flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, with NO shadows on the background, no ground shadow, no frames, no tiles, no cards, no borders, no grid lines. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers or labels anywhere. Do not use magenta or pink-purple colours inside any icon.
